description: This file defines the ClusterMember class, representing a member of a cluster in Orleans. It includes properties such as SiloAddress, Status, and Name, along with equality and string methods.

classes.name: ClusterMember
classes.description: Represents a member node in a cluster with address, status, and name properties.

methods.name: ClusterMember
methods.description: Constructor initializing a ClusterMember with address, status, and name.
